parameter.name: host
parameter.label: Host
parameter.description: The hostname or IP address of the Balboa Unit

parameter.name: port
parameter.label: Port
parameter.description: The port to connect to, default is 4257.

parameter.name: reconnectInterval
parameter.label: Reconnect Interval
parameter.description: Number of seconds to wait before the first reconnect attempt. Further attempts back off exponentially (doubling each time, capped at 10 minutes) for as long as the connection stays down.

parameter.name: pollingInterval
parameter.label: Polling Interval
parameter.description: Number of seconds to between polling packets.

parameter.name: syncClock
parameter.label: Synchronize Clock
parameter.description: Set the unit's clock to the openHAB time whenever it is off by more than one minute (checked on every status update, at most every five minutes). Keeps filter cycles on time across daylight saving changes.

channel-type.label: Temp. Range (Switch)
channel-type.description: Temperature Range as a plain Switch (ON = High, OFF = Low), for linking a Switch item directly without a second item and a profile.

channel-type.label: Heat Mode (Switch)
channel-type.description: Heat Mode as a plain Switch (ON = Ready, OFF = Rest/Ready in Rest), for linking a Switch item directly without a second item and a profile.

channel-type.label: Filter Status
channel-type.description: Filter Status

channel-type.label: Last Fault
channel-type.description: Description of the most recent entry in the unit's fault log, or NONE if it is empty.

channel-type.label: Last Fault Time
channel-type.description: When the most recent fault occurred, e.g. "2 days ago at 14:32". Best effort: the unit only reports the time of day and how many days ago, not an exact date/time.

channel-type.label: Filter Cycle Time
channel-type.description: Start time or duration of a filter cycle, as HH:MM. Writable: send HH:MM to change it (durations 00:15 to 24:00).

channel-type.label: Filter 2 (Switch)
channel-type.description: Enables (ON) or disables (OFF) the second filter cycle. Filter cycle 1 cannot be disabled.

channel-type.label: Fault Count
channel-type.description: Number of entries in the unit's fault log.

channel-type.label: Spa State
channel-type.description: Operating state of the control unit.

channel-type.label: Notification Pending
channel-type.description: OPEN while a reminder or notification is pending on the control panel.

channel-type.label: Clear Notification
channel-type.description: Send ON to clear a pending reminder or notification. Falls back to OFF.

channel-type.label: Panel Locked
channel-type.description: OPEN if the control panel is locked.

channel-type.label: Heat State
channel-type.description: Whether the heater is off, heating, or waiting to heat.

channel-type.label: Hold Mode
channel-type.description: Hold (standby) mode: pumps and heater stop for maintenance. ON while the unit is in hold mode.

channel-type.label: Circulation (Switch)
channel-type.description: Switches the circulation pump.

channel-type.label: Spa Time
channel-type.description: The unit's clock as HH:MM. Send HH:MM or a DateTime to set it.

channel-type.label: 24h Clock
channel-type.description: ON if the unit displays the time in 24h format, OFF for 12h format.

channel-type.label: Clock Offset
channel-type.description: How many minutes the unit's clock is ahead of (positive) or behind (negative) the openHAB time.

channel-type.label: Range Limit
channel-type.description: Lowest or highest target temperature the unit accepts in a range. Target temperatures are clamped to these limits before they are sent.

channel-type.label: Model
channel-type.description: Model of the control unit.

channel-type.label: Software Version
channel-type.description: Software id and version of the control unit.

channel-type.label: MAC Address
channel-type.description: MAC address of the Wi-Fi module.

channel-type.label: Filter 2 Enabled
channel-type.description: Whether the second filter cycle is enabled at all. Filter cycle 1 cannot be disabled.

channel-type.label: Last Seen
channel-type.description: Timestamp of the last message received from the unit, of any kind. Useful to detect a stale connection, e.g. via the Expire binding/profile.
